name: FormTask
caption: Form task

configuration.description: What the person should fill in, and why. Shown above the form. Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}. The task's subject is the step's description (fallback: the flow's description).
0 = a single user, 1 = a task group (any member can complete it). The editor always writes it. Any value other than 1 is treated as a user; there is no 'user who started the flow' mode on this step.

assignType 0: a Business Central user name (or user security ID). assignType 1: a task group code. Matched case-insensitively after trimming. Can be a SmartField resolved when the step runs. The user must exist and be enabled.
Optional. A date (yyyy-mm-dd is safest) or a SmartDate such as [@ calc(today, "+5D") @]. A value that does not resolve to a date is ignored silently (no due date).
Rows of { caption, name, kind, rowsFrom, allowAdd }. Optional: fields without a section form a section without a heading at the top of the form. The editor always writes the array.
The heading on the task card.

How fields and outputs refer to the section: letters and digits only, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique among all section and field names (case-insensitive). The editor derives it from the caption (camelCase) when left empty; write it yourself.
"normal" = fields one below the other; "repeater" = a table the person fills in row by row. Anything else counts as normal.

Repeater only: exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}' pointing to records (a reference, an array or an iterator) or to a value or an array of values. Read in its raw form. Each record or value becomes one prefilled row, at most 1,000. Empty: no prefilled rows.
Repeater only: true lets the person add and delete rows; false keeps the prefilled rows as they are.
Rows of { section, caption, name, type, required, value, options, freeText, tableNo, filters }. The form needs at least one field. The editor writes every key on every row.
The name of the field's section (case-insensitive). Empty, or a name no section has: the section without a heading at the top.
The label on the task card.

The name of the field's output (in a repeater: of the column): letters and digits only, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique among all field and section names (case-insensitive). The editor derives it from the caption (camelCase, 'Delivery date' -> deliveryDate) when left empty; write it yourself.
text, multiline, boolean, integer, decimal, date, datetime, dropdown, or reference (a record of fields[].tableNo). Empty counts as text.
true: the task can only be completed once the field is filled in. Has no effect on a boolean field.

Prefill. SmartText, resolved when the task is created. reference fields: exactly one placeholder '{{name}}' holding a record (the first record of an array); anything else prefills nothing. In a repeater with rowsFrom, a prefill that uses the rowsFrom name as its prefix (e.g. '{{FindCust_results.name}}' for rowsFrom '{{FindCust_results}}') is resolved once per row against that row's record or value; any other prefill is the same in every row.
dropdown only: the values to choose from, separated by ';' or line breaks. SmartText; an entry that is exactly one placeholder holding several values adds each of them.
dropdown only: true lets the person type a value that is not in the list.
reference only: the table whose records the field offers. 0 for every other type.

reference only: rows of { fieldNo, filter } that limit the offered records, like the filters of Find Records. 'filter' is SmartText resolved against the flow when the task is created. [] for no filter and for every other type.
A preview next to the form that follows what the person enters: 0 = none, 1 = HTML (previewHtml), 2 = a document (previewDocument). Any other value counts as none.

previewKind 1: the HTML the preview shows. SmartText that is rendered live on the task card, not when the task is created. Besides earlier steps' outputs it can use the form's own fields under the step's own slug: '{{<slug>_<field>}}', '{{<slug>_<section>}}' (a repeater's rows, e.g. in a {#for ... #} loop) and '{{<slug>_<section>Count}}'.

previewKind 2: one placeholder '{{name}}' that holds a reference to an Incoming Document Attachment or an AutoFlow document. It can be one of the form's own reference fields ('{{<slug>_<field>}}'), so the preview follows the person's choice.

outputs.name: <fields[].name>
outputs.when: one per field that is not in a repeater section, in fields order; type 'reference' with that field's tableNo when fields[].type = "reference". Values are text: true/false, 12, 1.25, 2026-11-02, 2026-11-02T09:30:00. An empty reference field writes no output.

outputs.name: <sections[].name>
outputs.when: one per repeater section: the rows the person entered. {{slug_section}} is the first row, {{slug_section[i]}} the i-th (0-based). The declared output also carries "columns": [{ name, type: "value" | "reference", tableNo (reference only) }], one entry per field of the section - Read task repeater and For Each take their columns from it.

outputs.name: <sections[].name>Count
outputs.when: one per repeater section, right after its rows output: the number of rows

outputs.name: completedBy
outputs.when: once completed - user name of who completed the task

outputs.name: task
outputs.when: once completed - the task record (table 5564323 mse365 AF-CO Task)

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while the instructions are empty. (The step's own check 'Enter the instructions for the person who fills in the form.' is not run.)
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while the assignee is empty. At runtime an empty assignee fails the step. (The step's own check 'Choose who completes the task: a user or a task group.' is not run.)
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: The flow's trigger runs inline and cannot wait for a person: 5564529 record created or modified (interactive), 5564543 document released, 5564549 document posted, 5564409 document reopened, 5564407 page opened, 5564408 page closed, 5564405 PDF printed, 5564406 report file name, 5564404 SubFlow. Hard error. The step is also hidden from the step list in such flows.
rules.message: The task step '%1' cannot be used in this flow: its trigger runs while the user works on the record (or answers right away), so the flow cannot wait for a person there. Use a trigger that runs in the background, such as a record trigger, a schedule or a manual start.

rules.check: Field and section names: letters and digits only, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique across fields and sections (case-insensitive). The step's own checks ('The name '%1' is not valid: use letters and digits only, at most %2 characters, starting with a letter.', 'The name '%1' is used more than once. Field and section names must be unique.', 'The field '%1' is in section '%2', which does not exist.', 'The repeater section '%1' has no fields.') are not run.

A reference field needs tableNo, a dropdown needs options, previewKind 2 needs previewDocument, and in a repeater with rowsFrom a prefill that contains SmartFields should use the rowsFrom name as its prefix. The step's own checks ('Choose the table of the record field '%1'.', 'Enter the values of the dropdown '%1'.', 'Choose the document the preview shows.', 'The prefill of '%1' must use the rows of its section, for example {{%2.Name}}.') are not run.
configuration.fields holds no field. (The step's own check 'Add at least one field to the form.' is not run in the editor.)
A fields[].filters row of a reference field cannot be applied to its field (%1 = field name, %2 = field number)
rules.message: The filter of the record field '%1' cannot be applied to field %2.

rules.check: The step runs inside an inline frame (backstop for the publish check)
rules.message: Task steps cannot run in a trigger that runs while the user works on the record (for example when a document is released, posted or modified). Run the task from a flow with a background trigger instead.

rules.check: The step runs in a flow executed as a sub-flow
rules.message: Task steps cannot run inside a sub-flow. Put the task step into the calling flow.

rules.check: assignee resolves to an empty text
rules.message: The task has no assignee. Choose a user or a group in the step.

rules.check: assignType 0 and no Business Central user has that user name (or user security ID)
rules.message: The task cannot be assigned to user %1: the user does not exist.

rules.check: assignType 0 and the user is disabled
rules.message: The task cannot be assigned to user %1: the user is disabled.

rules.check: assignType 1 and no task group has that code
rules.message: The task cannot be assigned to group %1: the group does not exist.

rules.check: The task was cancelled (by an administrator, or because the run was deleted) while the flow waited

notes: The form is built once, when the task is created: prefills, dropdown values, the records a reference field offers (its table in primary-key order, filtered, at most 1,000) and a repeater's prefilled rows (at most 1,000) are a snapshot. Only the preview is rendered live on the task card.

The flow waits in the background like the Approval task: parked, checked every poll interval (AutoFlow Setup 'Task Poll Interval (Min.)', default 5 minutes), and continued immediately when the user the flow runs as completes the task themselves. Each loop pass creates its own task; a retried run reuses the task it created.
Completing a form task needs a paid AutoFlow licence and an AutoFlow Tasks seat. Assigning needs no seat.
In a Webhook flow with WaitForResponse, put the step after Respond to Webhook: in the synchronous phase the step cannot park and fails.

On completion, rows of a repeater in which every cell is empty are dropped. Each remaining row becomes a SmartObject record (table 5564267) whose fields are the section's columns: a reference column a reference, everything else a value.
Output names are cut at 30 characters by the engine; the 20-character limit on names leaves room for '[999]' and 'Count'.
